title: Cloud Save Phase 2 — Server-owned Save Envelope

requirements.requirement: Cloud Save Envelope 由單一後端模組管理 ownerUid、schemaVersion、serverRevision、server timestamps 與狀態一致性。
bootstrapCloudSave 在同一 Session-protected transaction 建立 Revision 1 空 envelope；重複 bootstrap 不改 Revision，既有 Phase 1 精確骨架受控升級。
migration candidate metadata 只在可信後端交易中變更，並原子遞增 serverRevision；Browser timestamp 不決定正式先後。
owner/schema/revision/timestamp/status 或 payload 邊界損壞時 fail closed；Phase 2 不接受 authoritative gameplay state，也不從本機覆蓋雲端。
專屬 CI 必跑 Envelope unit、trusted backend 與 Auth/Firestore/Functions emulator；只有 dev exact SHA 與 Repository checks 成功後才能部署既有受保護 Functions 與 Rules。

verification.focusedTests: PASS locally — 21/21 cloud envelope, trusted backend and session-client tests.
verification.emulator: BLOCKED locally — runner only has Java 17; Firebase CLI 15.30.0 requires Java 21. The repository workflow installs Java 21 and must provide the authoritative emulator result.
verification.firebaseDeploy: PENDING — must deploy from merged latest dev SHA only.
